disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder; clinical cohort from ABIDE I and ABIDE II. Normative modeling applied to autistic individuals as clinical cohort (N=690 males in primary NM analysis; N=861 total autism before analysis-specific exclusions). Primary analyses conducted in males only due to limited female sample size.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Autism spectrum disorder ('autism') is a neurodevelopmental condition characterized by substantial behavioral and neuroanatomical heterogeneity."

dataset-of-origin.detail: ABIDE I (17 sites, N=539 autism, N=573 NAI) and ABIDE II (19 sites, N=521 autism, N=593 NAI) combined. Total autism pre-exclusion N=861.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We combined the ABIDE repositories I (Di Martino et al., 2014) and II (Di Martino et al., 2017). ABIDE I includes a total of 1,112 participants (539 autism, 573 NAI) from 17 different sites, and ABIDE II includes 1,114 participants (521 autism, 593 NAI) from 19 different sites."

age.detail: From Table 1, autism group (N=861) before analysis-specific exclusions. Note: the normative modeling sample was N=690 males (age range 5–64 per Methods). Subgroup demographics (Table 2, N=499 clustering sample, males only): High-RRB subgroup (N=119) M=17.24, SD=10.25, range 5.9–62; Low-RRB subgroup (N=380) M=17.72, SD=9.31, range 5.3–59.

sex.detail: Female N=130 explicitly stated in Methods for total autism sample (N=861). Male N=731 estimated as 861−130=731. Female %=15.1%, male %=84.9% calculated from counts. Primary NM analyses conducted in males only; supplementary results include both sexes.
sex.supporting_text: "primary analyses were conducted in males only due to limited sample size of females (N autism = 130, N NAI = 280)"
